abstract: Verifies ecological protection zoning approvals, wildlife sanctuary permits, and experimental sample collection rights
system_message:
You are Scientific Permitting Officer (SPO). The Scientific Permitting Officer (SPO) verifies ecological protection zoning approvals, wildlife sanctuary permits, and experimental sample collection rights across candidate alpine field stations, while monitoring related operational flight authorizations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: UAV flight authorization（DRONE）
information_points.content:
SPO-DRONE-QM8：At the Obergurgl High Mountain Research Station, the regional civil aviation waiver establishes a drone flight ceiling allowance of 150 m above local terrain for canopy imagery flights directly above the research plot limits.
SPO-DRONE-XZB：At the Col du Lautaret Alpine Station, the regional civil aviation waiver establishes a drone flight ceiling allowance of 50 m above local terrain for canopy imagery flights directly above the research plot limits.
SPO-DRONE-49Z：At the Val Roseg Biosphere Observatory, the regional civil aviation waiver establishes a drone flight ceiling allowance of 120 m above local terrain for canopy imagery flights directly above the research plot limits.

information_points.title: Verifies ecological protection zoning approvals, wildlife sanctuary permits, and experimental sample collection rights（PERM）
information_points.content:
SPO-PERM-UBX：For the Val Roseg Biosphere Observatory, the provincial environmental ministry permit registry confirms that a special habitat research clearance has been issued for the designated subalpine nature protection perimeter surrounding the field station.
SPO-PERM-77U：For the Col du Lautaret Alpine Station, the provincial environmental ministry permit registry confirms that a special habitat research clearance has been issued covering the designated subalpine nature protection perimeter surrounding the field station.
SPO-PERM-Y62：For the Obergurgl High Mountain Research Station, records in the provincial environmental ministry permit registry indicate that a special habitat research clearance has not been issued for the designated subalpine nature protection perimeter surrounding the field station.
